cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

mechanism: A uses its pupil old field-testing habits to delegate the first practical proof of an invisible bridge, then accepts B better objection as reason for another test by B.
confusable: Not pushing B to cross blindly: A keeps assigning preliminary proof steps while withholding its own crossing.
comparison: Output recognition test versus contact and weight tests.
seedUse: D152 ditch/umbrella/stick/basket/weight; S05 cautious testing lessons.
